name: Francisca
source:
The Lady of the Wolf Clan. Lavan and Levi's mother.
She knows the circumstances of the protagonist and does all she can to protect her.
Since her husband, the Leader of the Wolf Clan, passed away, she's taken his former position.
She is the strong and gentle woman that the protagonist secretly wanted to be.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/psychedelica/aa-nisus/chara/?page=francisca]official website[/url]]
